properties.description: propagate_from carries `redo_list`. From the seeds (parts, quantities, kept outputs, decisions) it walks what kept outputs took as inputs; what a kept output documents, is a premise of, is depended on by, is the record of, or is the limit_source of; the parts GOVERNED_BY a reached decision; the parts a reached limit CONSTRAINS; the parts that DEPEND_ON a changed part; the quantities describing a part; and the model and drawing files REALIZING a part. Each row is listed once, nearest first, with its `via` and `because`. It reaches a decision that a calc record DOCUMENTS, which the radius itself does not walk. Not yet: grouping by trade, and which dependencies an agent drew unchecked. Code: crates/reflow2-core/src/owed.rs (redo_list), propagate.rs.
properties.name: propagate_from returns a change's redo list by kind: computations, decisions and limits, parts, quantities, models, drawings
